status: Editable preliminary assumptions, not approved loads or material allowables
lift_distribution: Elliptical over the supplied half span; normalized so the two exposed wings carry the full maneuver load. No inertial relief.
bulkhead_load_model: Both wing end faces receive upward shear and equal/opposite wing root bending moments. A distributed downward inertial load acts on the lower outside rim. Three constraints remove rigid modes only.
material_note: Assumed isotropic room-temperature elastic properties and conservative study stress ceiling. These are not certified 7050 forging allowables.
knockdown_note: Study allowance for imperfect restraints and initial shape. This chosen factor is not a validated imperfection model.
skin_bracing_note: Sensitivity case only. No skin or attachment stiffness exists in the current assembly. The unbraced case uses the full measured member length.
primary_local_model: Pocket floors: simply supported rectangular plates enclosing each pocket. Cross ribs: outstanding flat plates with one supported and one free longitudinal edge, k=0.43. Global bulkhead lateral buckling is not covered.

sources.title: NACA TN 3781, Handbook of Structural Stability Part I: Buckling of Flat Plates
sources.use: Classical elastic plate coefficients and boundary-condition sensitivity

sources.title: NACA TN 1750, Buckling Tests of Flat Rectangular Plates under Combined Shear and Longitudinal Compression
NACA TR 734, Critical Compressive Stress for Outstanding Flanges
FAA AC 65-15A, Airframe Handbook
sources.use: Longerons, stringers, skins and thin-wall structural sections

study: Wing-root architecture trade. Sizing assumptions, not released requirements.
scope: Two closed outer wing boxes BL1280-4200, two primary bulkhead gross membrane proxies, full-depth ribs and a calculated cap-turn tie allowance. Common outer tips beyond BL4200 and the rest of the airframe are excluded. Lift to BL4572 is retained.
stiffeners: Ideal attached T sections, 40 mm flange, web height min(40 mm, 30% of local minimum box depth), 2.5 mm wall. Included in mass and bending stiffness. Ribs at <=250 mm projected span pitch. No joint slip credit.
frame_scope: Same 60 mm axial envelope and 12 mm ribs. Pocket floor is sized to local elastic buckling and a mesh-dependent stress screen. Gross profiles omit holes and rolling-ball volume. Out-of-plane frame stability and complete joint stresses are open.
joint_scope: Cap-turn tie area from the change in cap-force direction and the assumed stress ceiling. Additional joint, fastener, fitting and assembly mass is varied separately, not presented as measured.
stiffness_scope: Fixed-root thin-wall spatial beam with closed-cell torsion and web shear compliance. Deflection/twist targets are assumed comparison gates, not aeroelastic requirements.
